label: Cloud
depicts: Rounded cloud loop with one open curl on the right side
use_when: Use when the interface wants a rounded cloud loop with an open curl on one side.
avoid_when: Do not use for the puffy cloud when the outer outline should stay fully closed.

label: Currency Baht
depicts: Baht currency sign centered inside a thin outer ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants the baht currency symbol enclosed inside a thin circular ring.
avoid_when: Do not use for the standalone baht symbol when no outer ring should surround the sign.

label: Currency Baht
depicts: Standalone baht currency sign with two rounded right loops
use_when: Use when the interface wants the baht sign alone with no surrounding ring.
avoid_when: Do not use for the ring baht symbol when the sign should sit inside a full circle frame.

label: Currency Bitcoin
depicts: Bitcoin currency sign centered inside a thin outer ring

avoid_when: Do not use for the standalone bitcoin symbol when no outer ring should remain around it.

label: Currency Bitcoin
depicts: Standalone bitcoin currency sign with two vertical strokes across the center
